notes.title: Demo UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[b]Demo UPDATE![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219563/df98f3787a43587c61064d9518bc346f5bf93f99.jpg[/img]

Please, enjoy an improved Demo which includes:

[list][*]New pretty cutscenes,
[*]A charming detective and several new NPCs,
[*]New little quests,
[*]Autosave system,
[*]Re:do can run! ^^
[*]A couple of Easter eggs, and many minor adjustments.[/list]

[i]P.S. Unfortunately, I had to give up on the Japanese localization.ːsteamsadː Yet, I hope I'll be able to implement it to the final game.[/i]
